what: Catalogue records for J.R.R. Tolkien's published artwork, from two catalogues, joined on folded title. TITLES, SHELFMARKS, MEDIA AND PLACES OF REPRODUCTION ONLY. No image data of any kind is carried here and none is served: Tolkien's and Christopher Tolkien's artwork is not republished by this archive. Text metadata about a drawing is not the drawing.

catalogues.title: Tolkien Art Index
catalogues.gives: repository shelfmarks, media, subjects, and structured reproduction rows
catalogues.caveat: two parses of this page exist; the one used here carries 1772 reproduction rows over 62 books, the earlier 1720 over 61. The difference is one book, 'Tolkien Estate web site', that the earlier parse dropped. The later parse is a checked superset.

join.on: title, folded: NFKD, combining marks dropped, non-alphanumerics dropped, casefolded, whitespace collapsed
join.what: A CROSS-REFERENCE, NOT A MERGE. `rows` keeps every record from both catalogues; this says which folded titles occur in both, by row index.
join.caveat: THIS IS A FLOOR ON AGREEMENT, NOT A MEASUREMENT OF IT. Two catalogues describing one drawing under different titles read here as two works.
